name: 涟漪 (Ripple) v0.1.21
body:
## 更新内容 / What's New（安卓 v0.1.21）

这一版修了从公众号文章里点开视频号时拦不住的问题，设置里可以导出诊断日志，也加强了无障碍服务的防崩保护。

**修复：从公众号文章里点开视频号拦不住**

我们在一台 OPPO 手机上查到，微信的公众号文章页，以及从文章里的视频卡片点进去的视频号页面，微信不让无障碍服务看到。涟漪看不到这些页面，所以既不计时也不拦截。

这一版改为同时看系统的使用记录。开着视频号限制时，涟漪大约每秒读一次使用记录，发现微信停在视频号页面而无障碍服务看不到，就按返回退出去。设成「先给几分钟」的照样计时，用完弹出「时间到了」页面。微信从后台切回这类页面时，每日时长计时和时段拦截也会照常算。

使用记录比平时的判断慢一点，可能要一两秒才退出。公众号文章本身不拦。文章里直接播放的视频暂时拦不到。这个修复只在模拟器上用模拟的页面测过，还没有在真机上用真实微信测。

**新增：导出诊断日志**

「设置 › 关于」里加了「导出诊断日志」，点一下会把日志拼成一个文本文件，用系统分享发出去。拦截不正常时，可以把它发给我们。日志存在手机本地，记的是页面名称、开关和权限状态、拦截和计时的过程、网络请求的状态码，以及涟漪上次是怎么退出的。不记聊天内容，也不读屏幕上的文字。

**修复：崩溃和无障碍服务异常**

无障碍服务和后台计时里出错时，现在只记进诊断日志，不会让涟漪整个退出。以前一旦崩溃，系统会停掉无障碍服务，之后各项限制都不再拦截。读页面时一次最多看 3000 个节点，单个窗口出错只跳过这个窗口。拦截页面画不出来时，「时间到了」页直接关掉，其他拦截回到桌面。

另外修了一个问题：「先给几分钟」用完时，涟漪有时会连按两次返回，在慢一点的手机上第二下会把刚弹出的「时间到了」页面关掉。现在同一项 3 秒内只按一次。

**新增：QQ 群**

「设置 › 关于」里「联系我们」下面加了一行 QQ 群 1128312985，点一下复制群号，在 QQ 里搜群号就能加入。

已知限制：从文章点开视频号的修复还没有在真机上测。小米手机没有复测。部分手机打开受限应用时，仍可能短暂露脸。

iPhone 版没有更新，仍是 v0.1.5。签名证书没有变，已经装了旧版的可以直接覆盖升级。

## What's New (Android v0.1.21)

This release fixes Channels opened from an Official Account article not being blocked, adds a diagnostic log you can export from Settings, and adds crash protection to the accessibility service.

**Fixed: Channels opened from an Official Account article was not blocked**

On an OPPO phone we found that WeChat hides the Official Account article page, and the Channels page opened from a video card in an article, from accessibility services. Ripple could not see these pages, so it neither counted time nor blocked them.

Ripple now also reads the system usage records. With the Channels limit on, it checks them about once a second. If WeChat is on a Channels page that accessibility cannot see, Ripple presses Back. "Allow a few min" still counts time, and the time-up page opens when it runs out. When WeChat is switched back to one of these pages from the background, daily limits and schedules count it as usual.

Usage records are a little slower, so leaving the page can take a second or two. The article itself is not blocked. Videos that play inside an article are not blocked yet. This fix was tested only on an emulator with a simulated page and has not yet been tested on a real phone with real WeChat.

**New: export the diagnostic log**

Settings › About & Privacy now has "Export Diagnostic Log". Tap it to put the log into one text file and send it with the system share sheet. If blocking acts up, you can send it to us. The log stays on your phone and records page names, settings and permission states, blocking and timing steps, status codes of network requests, and how Ripple last exited. It has no chat content and does not read text on screen.

**Fixed: crashes and accessibility service failures**

Errors inside the accessibility service and the background timer are now written to the diagnostic log instead of stopping Ripple. Before, a crash made the system stop the accessibility service, and limits stopped blocking. Ripple now reads at most 3000 nodes per page, and an error in one window only skips that window. If a block page fails to draw, the time-up page closes and other block pages go to the home screen.

Also fixed: when "Allow a few min" ran out, Ripple sometimes pressed Back twice, and on slower phones the second press closed the time-up page that had just opened. It now presses Back once per item within 3 seconds.

**New: QQ group**

Settings › About & Privacy now lists the QQ group 1128312985 below Contact Us. Tap it to copy the number, then search it in QQ to join.

Known limits: the fix for Channels opened from an article has not been tested on a real phone. This build has not been retested on a Xiaomi phone. On some phones, a restricted app may still flash briefly when opened.

The iPhone app is unchanged and remains v0.1.5. The signing certificate is unchanged, so you can install this over an older version.
